labels.swarmItem: build-poms (root pom.xml / build files — you exclusively own hadoop-project/pom.xml and module pom.xml files): bouncycastle-1-68, gson-2-9-0, jackson-2-13-0, jackson-version-bump, jackson1-runtime-scope, jackson-1-pruning, netty-4-1-72, xerces-java-2-12-2, hbase1-1-7-1, jetty-9-4-44, jetty-9-4-48-upgrade, license-binary-jetty-version, year-2022-metadata, cos-api-bundle-bump, illegal-imports-enforcer, banned-illegal-imports-enforcer, maven-rules-static-imports, restrict-guava-preconditions-imports, visiblefortesting-enforcer-rule, exclude-avrorecord-classes, shadedclient-test-jaxb, yarn-csi-os-maven-plugin, website-release-notes-changelog, remove-stale-yarn-readme. native-cmake (HDFS native C/C++ code and CMake files): cmake-fetchcontent-gtest, openssl-link-check, protobuf-headers-first, remove-strings-h-inclusions, windows-ssize-t, windows-cmake-args, defined-directive-if-checks.

abfs (hadoop-tools/hadoop-azure ABFS module): abfs-global-test-timeout, abfs-listfiles-test-failure, abfs-rename-metadata-recovery, abfs-rename-recovery-removal. Note: do abfs-rename-recovery-removal (HADOOP-18002, removes rename idempotency recovery) and abfs-rename-metadata-recovery (HADOOP-18242) carefully — they touch related rename code; read both yamls first to order them sensibly.

cross-platform-tools (HDFS shell/cmd scripts, e.g. hadoop-hdfs-project/hadoop-hdfs/src/main/bin/hdfs and hdfs.cmd, and related scripts): hdfs-du-cross-platform, hdfs-get-cross-platform, hdfs-ls-cross-platform, hdfs-setrep-cross-platform, hdfs-stat-cross-platform, hdfs-tail-cross-platform, hdfs-transfer-tools-cross-platform, snapshot-tools-cross-platform, cross-platform-env-vars. Note: cross-platform-env-vars is YARN-11078 (setting env vars in a cross-platform way, likely in yarn container/scripts code) — read its yaml for the exact location.

docs-scripts (documentation, web UI JS, and dev-support scripts only): yarn-ui2-jquery, jquery-ui-1-13-1, moment-js-2-29-2, unixshellguide-typo, yarn-doc-wording, resourcemanager-rest-api-docs, namenode-acl-description, webhdfs-snapshotdiff-listing-docs, rbf-rpc-isolation-docs, git-jira-id-extraction, jira-fixversion-discrepancy-tool. Notes: jquery/moment upgrades replace the .js files under webapps static dirs (find existing jquery/moment files and replace with the new version's minified source; check the yamls for versions). git-jira-id-extraction and jira-fixversion-discrepancy-tool concern dev-support/git-jira-fix-version-check scripts.

s3a-1 (hadoop-tools/hadoop-aws): s3a-syncable-downgrade, s3autils-limitedprivate-methods, s3a-vectored-iostats, vectored-stats-propagation, s3a-public-dataset-testutils. Note: vectored-stats-propagation (HADOOP-18392) and s3a-vectored-iostats (HADOOP-18227) both touch vectored IO stats — do them sequentially and carefully.

s3a-2 (hadoop-tools/hadoop-aws plus hadoop-aliyun): s3a-bulk-delete-throttling-test, s3select-seek-timeout-test, rename-bulk-delete-batching, sts-client-shutdown, accesspoint-arn-endpoint-translation, aliyun-oss-tempfile-deletion, oss-listobjectv2-support.

common-rpc (hadoop-common ipc: Server.java, RpcMetrics, protobuf rpc engine): rpc-method-metrics-init, rpc-reader-call-debuglog, rpc-request-rate-metrics, rpcmetrics-inflight-handlers, sasl-invalid-token-handshake, ipcloggerchannel-lambda-cleanup.

common-util-1 (hadoop-common util/io/logging cleanups): afterexecute-interruption-logging, getwrappedstream-public-stable, hashset-treeset-constructors, io-file-buffer-size, redundant-semicolon-cleanup, utf8-charsets, cli-missing-user-warnings, httprequest-uri-accessor, slf4jrequestlog-httprequestlog. hdfs-balancer (hadoop-hdfs balancer/mover/diskbalancer): balancer-stale-storage-blocks, balancer-standby-namenode-logging, striped-block-balancer-npe, mover-thread-threshold, diskbalancer-exception-placeholder.

hdfs-blockmanager (hadoop-hdfs server blockmanagement package): blockinfo-assert-message, blockmanager-log-format, blockmissingexception-error-message, corrupt-replica-invalidation-threshold, excess-redundancy-striped-logging, striped-block-deletion-safety, remove-block-deletion-increment, rename-typeconsumed-storagepolicy. hdfs-namenode (hadoop-hdfs namenode server code, incl. HA/lifeline): setreplication-noop-editlog, lock-opname-operations, lease-recheck-interval-validation, decommission-lost-datanode, datanode-monitor-write-lock, ec-single-dn-rack-decommission, snapshot-diff-snapshotable-error, namenodeheartbeatservice-lazy-debug-logging, namespaceinfo-log-standardization, remote-namenode-address, lifelinesender-negative-wait.

hdfs-slowpeer (slow peer/slow datanode detection in hdfs client+server): slow-datanode-reconfigurable, slow-peer-jmx-reconfig, slowpeer-collect-nodes-reconfigurable, namenode-slow-peer-reconfigure, slow-peer-outlier-metrics, slow-node-latency-reporting, slownode-badnode-pipeline-recovery. Note: several of these add reconfigurable namenode configs — check how prior reconfig support (e.g. from already-done slow-datanode work) is structured.

hdfs-datanode-1 (hadoop-hdfs datanode dataset/scanner): directoryscanner-regular-file-check, directoryscanner-stats-tostring, fsdatasetimpl-lock-without-gs, checknotnull-fsdatasetspi-access, replica-reserved-space-release, metadata-latency-typo, sync-file-range-warning-context, slotreleaser-socket-path-reuse.

hdfs-datanode-2 (hadoop-hdfs datanode block reporting + peer metrics): blockreport-interval-reconfigurable, blockreport-lease-datanode-address, fbr-lease-id-logging, full-block-report-timing, first-storage-report-datanode, logeveryblock-info-level, peer-metrics-stale-records, remove-stale-peer-metrics, revert-peer-metrics-pruning. IMPORTANT: peer-metrics-stale-records and remove-stale-peer-metrics are both HADOOP-17995 (duplicate requirement) — read both yamls, then split the implementation into two logical commits (e.g. main change under peer-metrics-stale-records, remaining part/cleanup under remove-stale-peer-metrics) so each slug gets a non-empty diff. Afterwards, revert-peer-metrics-pruning is 'Revert HADOOP-17995': use `git revert --no-commit <the two commits>` (or manually undo), then `git diff --cached > requirement_patches/revert-peer-metrics-pruning.diff` and commit it — final tree state should be as if HADOOP-17995 was never applied, but all three diffs must be non-empty.
hdfs-journal (JournalNode / qjournal): jnstorage-currentdir-removal, journalnode-storage-jmx, journalnode-web-start-time, minijournalcluster-http-rpc-ports.

hdfs-sps (StoragePolicySatisfier): external-sps-jmx-metrics, revert-external-sps-jmx, sps-reconfigure-unit-test, sps-single-instance-start, dispatcher-visiblefortesting. IMPORTANT: first implement external-sps-jmx-metrics (HDFS-16488, expose JMX metrics for external SPS) and commit it. Then revert-external-sps-jmx is its revert: `git revert --no-commit <that commit>`, write the diff to requirement_patches/revert-external-sps-jmx.diff, and commit — final tree state as if it was never applied, both diffs non-empty. Then do the remaining three SPS requirements.
hdfs-webhdfs (WebHDFS/HttpFS/fsck/verifyec): webhdfs-path-validation, httpfs-snapshot-diff-listing, fsck-read-timeout-config, verifyec-debug-tool.

hdfs-tools-offline (oiv/offline image viewer, dfsadmin, test deflaking, k8s locality): oiv-ec-policy-output, reversexml-snapshotdiffsection-support, dfsadmin-reconfig-livenodes, dfsadmin-topology-output-test, rolling-upgrade-rollback-deflake, rack-fault-tolerant-test-config, kubernetes-data-locality-addendum.

Notes: hdfs-preconditions-removal removes Guava Preconditions usage from hdfs modules only (do NOT touch the root pom — another agent owns it). yarn-visiblefortesting-annotation replaces Guava @VisibleForTesting with org.apache.hadoop.classification.VisibleForTesting in hadoop-yarn-project modules. unused-import is YARN-11130.

rbf-rpc (hadoop-hdfs-rbf RouterRpcServer and related): rbf-available-ns-retry, rbf-invokeatavailablens-retry, router-rpc-reload-lambda, rbf-dynamic-handler-allocation, revert-rbf-handler-allocation, routerid-without-routerrpc, router-haservicestatus-lifeline-rpc. Do the retry-logic fixes (rbf-available-ns-retry before rbf-invokeatavailablens-retry) carefully as they touch the same invokeAtAvailableNs code.

Note: router-pipeline-utils (YARN-6572) refactors Router services to common util classes for pipeline creation — coordinate by doing router-application-flow-refactor after it if they touch the same files.

Note: these are refactors in hadoop-yarn-server-resourcemanager capacity package — keep behavior identical, move/simplify code as the yamls describe.

yarn-conf-store (yarn scheduler conf store + client retry): mutation-api-config-deletion-tests, zkconfigurationstore-node-acls, leveldb-confirmmutation-write, delegation-token-expiry-test, rmadmincli-kerberos-retry.

yarn-misc (misc yarn/mapreduce/timeline/sls): times-util-datetimeformatter, skip-reparsed-timeline-logs, timeline-entity-table-routing, timeline-putentities-failfast, sls-duplicate-job-ids, junit-5-ahs, distributedcache-api-decoupling.
